4.text: Intel's CFO signaled confidence about naming a major outside customer for its next process by 2027, a deadline Intel set itself. Intel stock rose 25% over five days on CPU demand tied to AI agents.

5.text: US equity indexes rose, led by tech and chip stocks, with the Nasdaq hitting a record as oil prices and Treasury yields fell. Markets also climbed on US-Iran peace hopes after Iran proposed conditionally reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

6.text: Micron’s stock has surged roughly 550–575% over the past year, though about 40% of its revenue will face fixed prices or ceilings. The SOX index rose as four new names joined, then slid Wednesday after a six-day climb.

7.text: Intel stock surged sharply, with reports citing gains of 25% in five days, 30% in a month, 220% in 2026, and over 250% in a year, alongside NVIDIA's $5 billion stake. Analysts debated valuation, citing narrowing foundry losses, rising data center and AI demand, and price targets ranging from $145 to $165.

8.text: Meta's Muse AI agent hit No. 1 on the U.S. free iPhone app chart, sparking a chip rally: Intel jumped 12%, AMD rose 9% and crossed $1 trillion, and Arm surged 13%. Investors bet agentic AI will boost CPU demand, though Meta disclosed no Intel deployment and Nvidia is pushing its own AI CPUs.

9.text: Qualcomm launched 2nm Snapdragon chips for agentic AI and premium phones, while its stock rose 37% over six months. Google unveiled Gemini-powered Googlebooks targeting premium laptops, challenging Apple and Windows makers.
